name: modresorts-css-build
description: CSS optimization pipeline for ModResorts production container — cz-css-1004 (minification) and cz-css-1005 (PurgeCSS unused-rule removal) for GKE Autopilot deployments via Google Cloud Build and Artifact Registry.

scripts.minify-css: postcss WebContent/pikaday.css --use cssnano --no-map -o WebContent/pikaday.css && postcss WebContent/styles.css --use cssnano --no-map -o WebContent/styles.css
scripts.minify-css:ci: postcss WebContent/pikaday.css --use cssnano --no-map -o dist/pikaday.min.css && postcss WebContent/styles.css --use cssnano --no-map -o dist/styles.min.css
scripts.optimize-css: npm run purge-css && npm run minify-css
scripts.optimize-css:ci: purgecss --config purgecss.config.js --output dist/ && postcss dist/styles.css --use cssnano --no-map -o dist/styles.min.css && postcss dist/pikaday.css --use cssnano --no-map -o dist/pikaday.min.css
